name: okdata
description: Fetches public data from 17 social and content platforms, including Douyin, Xiaohongshu, WeChat, TikTok, X and YouTube, for AI agents over an API or a remote MCP server, paid per call.

skills.name: Find Endpoints
skills.description: Finds the endpoint for a need described in plain English or Chinese among 214, with its price and a ready-made call; free and needs no key.

skills.name: Describe Endpoints
skills.description: Returns the parameters, examples, paging, returned fields and the most one call can cost for up to five endpoints; free and needs no key.

skills.name: Fetch Platform Data
skills.description: Fetches one page of public data, such as videos, notes, comments, profiles or articles, from one endpoint, charged per call; failed calls are free.

skills.name: Read Long Results
skills.description: Returns the rest of a result that was cut to fit, or the same result with other fields, without fetching again or charging.

skills.name: Check Balance and Usage
skills.description: Reports the balance, spending limits, per-call receipts and usage by day or endpoint for the account behind the key.
